text_content: Aarav Vivaan ke liye wet wipes 1 pack
jumbo pack almari me hai, abhi diaper mat le
Mummy-ji ke liye haldi doodh wala packet
feed-neend copy le jana hai polyclinic. dono ka wazan wala page khula rakhna. booklet bhi bag me dalna, bhoolna nahi. Mummy-ji bolegi subah jaldi nikalne ko.
stall pay aate hi - SP bill 92.15 wala, phone 20 wala, town council 68 wala nikal dena. chaar-room goal ke 320 alag POSB me. CDC voucher se rashan + diaper, cash mat chhuna.
16 wala checkup ho gaya. dard pehle se kam bola unhone. dawai time pe deni hai. 21 wala teeka dono ko lag gaya, booklet me stamp aa gaya. bukhar wala syrup ghar pe ready rakhna.
Rohit wala BBQ void deck me -
bachcho ka extra diaper + chhota pack se 4-5 piece
Mummy-ji ki shawl, raat ko hawa lagti hai
Imran ko haan bola hai 11 Oct van help ke liye. Tuas side engagement samaan uthana hai. shift se pehle Suresh ko bolna hoga. Latha se swap ho jaye to best rahega.
teaser list aaj aaya. Jurong side option dekhna hai teen-room se chaar-room ke liye. paisa steady jod raha hu, jaldi nahi karna. naya roster me last week ghanta kam hua, Suresh se confirm karna hai.
